story: Apple reported record revenue while questions remained about iPhone demand and China.

demo_posts.text: Sample post: Apple's record revenue is encouraging, but I'm watching iPhone growth.
Sample post: Curious whether Apple Intelligence will drive more upgrades this year.
Sample post: Services growth looks strong, while China remains a question.

claims.claim: Apple reported record quarterly revenue of $124.3 billion, up 4% year over year.
claims.quote: Today, Apple is reporting revenue of $124.3 billion for the December quarter, up 4% from a year ago, and an all-time record.
claims.speaker: Tim Cook, CEO
claims.reason: Illustrative reaction: investors welcome the revenue record while looking closely at product growth.

evidence.summary: Sample investor reaction: The revenue record looks encouraging, but I want to see what drove the growth.

claims.claim: Apple highlighted its rollout of Apple Intelligence across devices and markets.
claims.quote: In October, we released the first set of Apple Intelligence features in U.S. English for iPhone, iPad, and Mac, and we rolled out more features and expanded to more countries in December.
claims.speaker: Tim Cook, CEO
claims.reason: Illustrative reaction: investors ask how quickly AI features will translate into iPhone sales.

evidence.summary: Sample analyst reaction: The rollout is promising, but its effect on upgrades remains to be seen.

claims.claim: Apple said services revenue reached a record $26.3 billion, up 14%.
claims.quote: Turning to services, we set an all-time revenue record of $26.3 billion for the December quarter, growing 14% from a year ago.
claims.speaker: Tim Cook, CEO
claims.reason: Illustrative reaction: investors see services growth as a positive alongside questions about hardware.

evidence.summary: Sample investor reaction: Services growth stands out, even as iPhone demand deserves a closer look.
